fields.Name: IT148 - Agent Execution Primitives and Multi-Step Loops (live providers)
fields.Description: LIVE-MODEL tier (real model calls cost tokens). Runs three specialized fixture Loop agents through AgentRunner on real native-tool-calling models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini via ITRecordingLLM) and verifies persisted MJ: AI Agent Runs, MJ: AI Agent Run Steps, MJ: Tasks, MJ: Task Dependencies, and MJ: Action Execution Logs. AEPL1: server-side Pipeline via JSON envelope bridge under native tool calling (19*23 + 100 = 537). AEPL2: in-turn ForEach with multi-step steps[] over [3, 7, 11] producing [14, 26, 38] and 6 child Actions steps. AEPL3: durable Tasks graph (2 connected Action nodes) parking the agent run and settling to Completed via TaskGraphDispatcher (144 -> 200). AEPL4: durable Tasks graph with a multi-step ForEach node over [4, 9] producing [42, 92] and settling the submitting agent run to Completed. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Zero provider protocol rejections across callable native-tool-calling providers; Pipeline, multi-step ForEach, and durable TaskGraph runs persist exact step lineage and arithmetic outputs and settle cleanly.
